nodes.label: Stock photo: La Nube coworking space in use — multiple people working at open-plan desks with laptops, modern white ergonomic chairs, desk dividers, exposed brick walls, large windows, indoor plants, and a projector screen displaying Spanish-language content ('minutos'); warm natural daylight; lively but focused atmosphere
nodes.visual_description: Photograph taken inside a coworking space. Six or more people — men and women of various ages — are seated at rows of long white desks separated by low grey dividers, each working on a laptop. The furniture is modern: white frame ergonomic mesh chairs with tan seat cushions. Walls are exposed brick; tall glass windows fill the left side with bright natural daylight. A large projector screen on the back wall shows a slide with the word 'minutos' and other Spanish text, suggesting a training session or workshop is in progress. A green tropical plant adds a natural accent near the windows. A fire extinguisher and emergency-exit sign are visible. The overall atmosphere is professional, productive, and community-oriented.
